label: verify-pp-funding-computational-biology

claims.claim: NSF eMB 25-509 is an annual call due March 1 with $2M-$6M total and 10-15 awards
claims.source_says: "March 02, 2026" and "March 1, Annually Thereafter"; "$2,000,000 to $6,000,000"; "Approximately 10 to 15 awards ... per year." The page states that this solicitation is archived.
claims.note: Numbers and dates match, but the page is marked archived, so presenting it as a live annual call is misleading.

claims.claim: NSF BIO Core 26-517 replaced the MCB core solicitation and accepts proposals any time
claims.source_says: "Replaces: NSF 24-543, NSF 24-546, NSF 24-539"; deadline "Proposals Accepted Anytime"
claims.note: The 26-517 page confirms both the replacement of 24-539 (MCB) and the anytime deadline.

claims.claim: Wellcome Discovery Awards have no deadline and average GBP 3.5M
claims.source_says: "There are no deadlines for applications to this scheme. Applications can be submitted at any time." "The average size of a Discovery Award is £3.5 million."

claims.claim: No programme read explicitly funds formal verification of biology
claims.note: This is a claim about absence across many pages, and I did not check all of them.

overall: Three claims were checked against primary pages. Two are supported and one is partly supported, because NSF eMB 25-509 is marked archived. The absence claim cannot be checked.
